title: Visual Search
subtitle: 1:N facial search against enrolled personnel face templates
disclaimer: Candidates are ranked by similarity and do not constitute confirmed identity. Manual verification is required.

dropzone.title: Upload Face Photo
dropzone.prompt: Drag & drop an image here, or click to select
dropzone.formatHint: Supports static JPG, PNG, and WebP (up to 10MB, max 4096px). Please upload a photo with a single clear face.
dropzone.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported file format. Only JPG, PNG, and WebP are supported.

controls.thresholdHint: Candidates below this similarity are filtered out (default 70%)

results.title: Search Results
results.idleDescription: Upload an image and click Search to look up matching face profiles in the database.
results.emptyDescription: No faces in the enrolled database met the similarity threshold. Try adjusting the threshold or providing a clearer front-facing photo.
results.errorDescription: An error occurred during search. Please check your network and try again.
